A block marker on a continuation line of a link label is escaped

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<a href=\"https://example.com\">Alpha<br>-<br>Beta</a>", options = ConversionOptions$default())
print(result$content)
```
